paragraphs.text: The dominion of the heavens and earth belongs to Allah. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills, and He is Forgiving and Merciful. Those who stayed behind ask to follow when the believers set out for booty, but they want to change Allah's words. They are told that they will not follow, and they accuse the believers of envy without understanding. The Bedouins will be called to face a people of great military might. Obedience brings a good reward, while turning away brings painful punishment. Blind people, lame people, and ill people are not guilty for staying behind. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger enters gardens with rivers; whoever turns away is punished. Allah was pleased with the believers who pledged allegiance beneath the tree. He knew their hearts, sent tranquillity, and rewarded them with a near conquest and much booty. He also promises future victories and guidance.

If the disbelievers of Makkah had fought the believers, they would have turned back without a protector or helper. Allah's established way does not change. At Makkah, He withheld both sides' hands after giving the believers victory. The disbelievers obstructed access to al-Masjid al-Haram and prevented the offering from reaching its place. Believing men and women whom the believers did not know were there; entering might have harmed them unknowingly. Allah admitted whom He willed to His mercy. Allah sent tranquillity to His Messenger and the believers and gave them the word of righteousness. The Messenger's vision was true: they would enter the Sacred Mosque safely, if Allah willed. Allah sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth. Muhammad is Allah's Messenger, and those with him are firm against disbelievers and merciful among themselves. They bow and prostrate, seeking Allah's bounty and pleasure. Allah promised forgiveness and a great reward to those who believe and do righteous deeds.
Believers are told not to put themselves ahead of Allah and His Messenger. They should fear Allah, who hears and knows.
